content: mongodb_driver v1.6.3 (released May 2026) is the recommended MongoDB driver for Elixir. API: Mongo.start_link/1 for connection, Mongo.insert_one/3, Mongo.insert_many/3, Mongo.find/3 (returns Enumerable stream), Mongo.update_one/4. Uses DBConnection 2.x for pooling via pool_size option. Mix dep: {:mongodb_driver, "~> 1.5"}. Not to be confused with the older 'mongodb' hex package which is unmaintained.
